scope: R2 native mount/source/lookup/read ownership with one atomic observation and bounded revocation, then Workspace/Daemon integration

files.overlay/contract/native.rs: NativeMount identity, generic atomic decision/attempt carrier preserving semantic observation even on transaction failure. Reuse BaseSource/FileRead rather than copied custody types.
files.overlay/lifetime/native.rs: One native mount per Workspace; implicit root lookup lease; exact source association using class2; checked aggregate nlookup and native read acquisition.
files.overlay/lifetime/native_observation.rs: Caller semantic decision over SourceRows inside one owner transaction; positive lookup count plus independent FileRead in that same transaction; first original outcome retained.
files.overlay/maintenance/native.rs: After explicit source/read drain and logical revocation, bounded lookup-lease retirement; existing orphan/close machinery remains authoritative.
files.overlay/sql/schema.sql and accounting.sq: Schema17 native mount/lookup/source/read relations and accounting; source class2; negative internal FileRead request keys distinct from public positive keys.
files.workspace/operations/native_read.rs: Stat/lookup fact rounds use existing Eval/BaseFacts semantics; no provider call in owner decision; retained source/custody through a resumable plan.
files.daemon/overlay/commands.rs: Typed native jobs through existing fair owner with bounded original completion charging; no alternate SQL service.

invariants: full mount/route identity and positive checked counts
implicit root reference survives count-zero FORGET
automatic bounded retirement after logical revocation, including closed namespaces
no new total inode/namespace/lookup cap or resident ownership map
no actual mount/Ready proof claimed by component
profiles: Overlay MEMORY/OFF/EXCLUSIVE only; Durable NOT_RUN disabled by owner
measurement: functional/paired SQL work evidence only, no performance claim
